FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is there a free trial?

Both AI Copilots are free to install from the Odoo Apps Store, with demo data included. No credit card required.

Do they work with Arabic/RTL?

Yes. AI POS Copilot is fully bilingual (Arabic and English) with RTL support, and prompts are customisable per language.

What Odoo versions are supported?

Both modules target Odoo 19, with Odoo 18 compatibility in progress.

Can I customise the AI behaviour?

Absolutely. Both modules include prompt templates, scoring rules and decision logs, with full API access.

What about data privacy?

All data stays within your Odoo instance — no external API calls for AI processing — and is GDPR-conscious.

How is this better than other POS apps?

Real-time processing, a bilingual UI, a clean architecture codebase, support and production deployments.

Ready to transform your business?

Install from the Odoo Apps Store today — no setup required, demo data included.
